Coverage, data sources & interpretation

What is ranked: a progressively loaded catalog of exact trust-line token identities. XRBC, XRB and JCS are known project identities; additional identities come from paginated XRPL Meta discovery, explicit name searches, or direct issuer/currency lookups. There is no 50-token total cap. The 10/25/50/100 selector controls displayed rows only. The directory does not apply a provider trust-level filter or alter permission to trade. The same liquidity measurements apply to every row. MPTs, token/token pools and order-book depth are outside this first index.

One ledger per check batch: up to 60 pool requests share a validated ledger hash. Completed checks appear progressively; the batch does not need to finish before results are shown. Checks for larger catalogs rotate through bounded batches, starting with never-checked or oldest observations. Recent results from different batches can share the table; the summary labels mixed ledgers and each row retains its exact ledger and time. Only fresh, successfully checked pools receive a rank or enter the reserve total. Older retained observations and failures remain visible but unranked. An unavailable lookup is never reported as zero liquidity.

Images: exact-identity local assets and Bithomp’s public token-image service, with allowlisted XRPL Meta cached-image fallback. Bithomp can aggregate issuer logos, verified-domain TOMLs and curated images, or provide a generated icon. A picture is not proof of identity, ownership or safety. Image requests disclose your IP address to the image provider, not your wallet.

Observations: reserves, fees, reported frozen state and changes between comparable snapshots. Reserve changes can arise from trades or liquidity operations; they do not establish a withdrawal or misconduct. Repeated-wallet, round-trip and volume-pattern analysis is not performed by this module. A row with no snapshot changes is not a clean bill of health.

Refresh: one bounded initial check, manual refresh and optional visible-section auto-checks; no account history scan or background collector. Metadata is loaded in bounded pages on demand; it is not an exhaustive AMM census. Holder-ranked discovery can omit pools until more records are loaded. Exact lookup bypasses metadata discovery, not any wallet access gate. Last observations are held only in this page session. Reloading starts a new comparison baseline. Failed checks stop or back off instead of repeatedly loading the proxy.

Tool access: browsing and exporting this index require no wallet. Linked tools keep their own established wallet-verification and XRBC-holding rules. This section never prepares a trade, trustline or signing request.

Protocol reference: XRPL amm_info. Report a reproducible discrepancy through official support.

No direct XRP AMM does not mean no order book or other trading route. Pool reserves are not a guaranteed exit quote or a price floor. Ledger observations and external metadata are reported separately.

Security. Non-custodial by design. This interface does not request or store seed phrases, private keys or recovery phrases. Signing occurs in Xaman; the Sentinel memo code helps match a wallet request to the action initiated here.

Ledger data. Order books, AMM lookups and ledger metrics are read-only. Public names/images are used only after exact issuer and currency matching. Auto-discovered markets remain view-first until current issuer, trustline, route, liquidity, transaction-shape and XRPL simulation checks pass.

AI-assisted review. Layout, client logic and security checks have been iteratively reviewed with OpenAI ChatGPT models. This is automated assistance, not a formal security certification or endorsement by OpenAI; independently inspect source and on-ledger evidence.

Risk & legal. Not financial advice, brokerage or a guarantee. XRPL transactions are effectively irreversible once validated; slippage and fees may apply. Verify the official domain before use, assess local legal obligations, and independently evaluate third-party assets and services.
